Government reduces broken rice in PDS, expects significant savings

The central government has reduced the permissible limit of broken rice in rice distributed through the Public Distribution System (PDS). This change is projected to result in savings of approximately ₹2,161 crore for the government. The new policy aims to streamline the PDS procurement and distribution process.
